title: Galaxy shooter browser game model comparison
title_zh: 星系射击网页游戏生成步骤及模型对比
promptText:
I gave the same galaxy shooter prompt to GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3.1 Pro. Same steps, same order, three browser tabs. 

-> Kimi's build is the one I kept playing, and it cost $0.31.

One rule for all three: never ask for "A space shooter". 
One system per prompt, play it, then the next.

Step 1 -> A canvas, a starfield, a ship that moves on arrows and touch. No enemies yet.

Step 2 -> Auto fire and one enemy type that dives. Play it until the dodge feels right.

Step 3 -> Waves. Each one tighter, with a "WAVE 2" banner so you know the game noticed.

Step 4 -> Power-ups: spread shot, shield, score bonus, each dropped from a kill.

Step 5 -> Score, best score, lives, a pause key, a game over screen that restarts on space.

Step 6 -> Each model reviews its own build and fixes what it finds before I touch anything.

What came back:

> GPT-6 Astra: $2.55, a ship, enemies, levels. Spread shot never landed.
> Opus 5.5: $1.93, clean levels and a proper HUD, no pause, no power-ups.
> Kimi K3.1 Pro: $0.31, waves, spread shot, pause, best score, game over, all working on the first run.

The split:

> HTML canvas: the whole game, zero libraries.
> The models: every line of code.
> Me: play, compare, keep the one that feels like a game.

Speed and cost decided this. Kimi K3.1 Pro on the high-speed version returned each step in seconds and landed at $0.31 total, about 8x cheaper than Astra and 6x cheaper than Opus for the most complete build of the three.

Commit after every step that works. 
A bad prompt costs seconds, not an evening.

promptText:

promptText:
Holy f*cking sh*t 

Gave 4 AIs the exact same prompt: “a fire truck at a burning building, night, sirens on” 🚒🔥

The results:

 Opus 5.5, $41
Wet asphalt reflections, flashing sirens, smoke you can almost smell. Looks like a movie still.
 Fable 5.5, $36
Nearly as good, and it was the only one that added firefighters spraying water. Nobody asked it to.

 Kimi K3.1, $112
Low-poly truck, cartoon fire. The most expensive one looks like a mobile game ad.
 GPT-6 Astra, $9
Built the whole thing out of blocks. Cheapest, fastest, and somehow it remembered a fire hydrant.

The price gap between best and worst: 2.7x. In the wrong direction.
Which one would you actually use? 

The most expensive one lost 💀
